notes: Fixes the cramped header on a phone. Both the title and the date were wrapping onto second lines — 'Motroni / Meadows' and 'Tuesday, September / 1' — which pushed the header down to nearly a third of the screen before you saw a single tile. Everything in the header now steps down a size on a phone, the title stays on one line, and the date reads 'Tue, Sep 1'. Turn the phone sideways and it goes back to the full-size version on its own. Nothing else changed.
